items.criterion: A committed cell value is the value stored in PostgreSQL and is returned on a re-read.
items.judgment: Read the record back through the API and the database after a commit.

items.criterion: A newly created object is addressable end to end with no further step.
items.judgment: Create an object, then list objects and read its records resource.

items.criterion: Every dependent of a schema change is listed with its kind, its name and the action taken.
items.judgment: Read the dependents resource for a field in use.

items.criterion: A lossy field type change is refused and reports the count of rows blocking it.
items.judgment: Convert a text field holding non-numeric rows to number.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous saves to one piece of metadata leave exactly one winner.
items.judgment: Fire two version-carrying patches at one object at once.

items.criterion: A row a permission rule hides is answered as not found.
items.judgment: Request another member's company row directly.

items.criterion: A hidden row moves no aggregate a member can read.
items.judgment: Compare each member's aggregate with the rows that member can list.

items.criterion: A hidden row is absent from search for the member who may not see it.
items.judgment: Search a company name as the member who does not own it.

items.criterion: A member calling an admin endpoint is denied and the protected state is unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the schema endpoints from a member session and count the metadata rows.

items.criterion: A caller with no session is refused at every workspace resource.
items.judgment: Call the workspace resources with no token.

items.criterion: One triggering event starts exactly one run of a workflow.
items.judgment: Change a stage once and count the runs.

items.criterion: A self-triggering workflow halts at a depth limit with a visible entry.
items.judgment: Trigger a workflow that edits the object it watches.

items.criterion: A workflow message reaches exactly the addressed inbox with the pinned subject prefix.
items.judgment: Run the seeded workflow and read the mail server.

items.criterion: A run refused at the credit gate delivers no message.
items.judgment: Exhaust the allowance, run the workflow and count the inbox.

items.criterion: A committed import is one undoable batch that restores the table exactly.
items.judgment: Dry-run, commit and undo an import while counting record rows.

items.criterion: Each public route carries a document title and a description of its own.
items.judgment: Read the head of every public route.

items.criterion: No credential reaches anything the browser downloads.
items.judgment: Fetch every public route and its script and style assets.

items.criterion: An unmatched address answers not found on the product's own page.
items.judgment: Request an address that matches no route.

items.criterion: The audit trail is append-only and filters by actor.
items.judgment: Attempt to edit an entry, then filter the trail.

items.criterion: Seeding is idempotent across a restart.
items.judgment: Count the seeded tables, reseed and count again.
